SITE SETTINGS Read get-site-settings before update-site-settings; send only intended properties. Use list-plugins for installed/active dependencies. A missing plugin is installed by the site admin. The settings tool is a limited interface, not a general option or siteurl writer. The home page, the posts page and the permalink structure are read here, not set: the site administrator sets them in Settings. Assigned home/blog/not-found pages cannot simply be trashed or deleted.
notFoundPage selects a published page for missing addresses; 0 restores the theme's behavior. It must not also be the home or posts page. Build one only when requested. Verify on an actually missing URL, including HTTP 404 and indexing behavior, not only the page's URL. The 404 body is that page's blocks unless the 404 template has a contentSource "404" rule. Block templates are managed through template-contract. Use siteIcon with a valid image attachment; inspect current values before replacing/clearing it. The active theme supplies design and layout.
